escena: SCENE (Efeonce office, Santiago, high floor, midday): the creative team work wall in the Efeonce studio area, seen from the chair of someone sitting there on a video call — camera at SEATED EYE LEVEL (about 1.15 m), 28 mm lens at f/5.6, like a good webcam view, looking straight at a 3 m wide pin-up wall of pale grey acoustic felt panels in slim black frames 2.5 m away; horizon level, verticals straight. Printed design proofs (A3 and A4 graphic layouts in navy, white, a little orange and one cobalt blue poster, their content abstract and illegible) are pinned to the felt with steel pins in the LEFT and RIGHT thirds; the CENTRE of the felt stays bare and calm. RIGHT THIRD: Image 2 is the final artwork of one proof pinned larger than the rest, at head height: a strip of cream paper tape across its top with the handwritten file name in black marker, the dark poster with its word and sphere, and the magenta rubber stamp «Aprobada.» — reproduce Image 2 exactly as real paper, tape, marker ink and a real stamp impression. LEFT THIRD, bottom: a low graphite handle-less credenza with the official Efeonce logo from Image 1 as a small solid WHITE desk object about 24 cm wide and 6 cm tall, standing upright on its top, between 4% and 22% of the frame width, turned towards the camera: product placement, reproduced exactly (every letter of «efeonce», the ship emblem with its orbit ring, its cuts and its three small windows), matte white finish, crisp bevel and, beside it, a slim borderless monitor on a thin stand whose screen shows Image 3 exactly (a design canvas with the «Idea.» poster selected by a blue box with eight square handles and a cursor tagged «Nexa»); on the side of the credenza two round vinyl stickers, a thin teal ring and a solid teal sphere. LIGHT: hard daylight from the RIGHT rakes across the felt at a low angle so every pin and paper edge casts a small crisp shadow; dust glows in the shaft. MODERN FLOOR (2026, premium technology company): floor-to-ceiling glazing with slim black frames; smooth exposed concrete ceiling with recessed black linear LED profiles switched off; seamless pale microcement floor; furniture with clean lines — pale solid-surface or light-oak tables on slim black steel legs, graphite ergonomic mesh chairs, handle-less storage; current-generation technology only. At most ONE sculptural plant in the whole frame. Nothing vintage or rustic: no reclaimed wood, no brass, no Edison bulbs, no wooden brackets, no clutter. Nothing else on the walls: no posters, no clocks, no extra signage and no extra text anywhere. TEXT EXCEPTION: the logo from Image 1 and the artworks from Image 2 and Image 3 are the ONLY readable marks in the picture; they stay crisp and legible, every letter and word exactly as in the references, never blurred, altered or translated; every other screen, paper or label stays illegible by physical means.
